description.narrative:
Contribute to peace through supporting engagement and where feasible dialogue at multiple levels between community groups and the current Taliban administration in line with UNAMA’s mandate to assist the government and people of Afghanistan in laying the foundations for sustainable peace and development, among them assisting national reconciliation and encouraging regional dialogue and engagement aimed at achieving and sustaining peace in Afghanistan.
Reactivate or reenergize existing traditional civil society structures to enable them to engage with the Taliban, thereby contributing to local social cohesion, to prevent further deterioration of their capacity and to enable them to participate in local peace activities.
Mitigate an increase in community-level conflict by preemptively supporting conflict-resolution, such objectives being in line with UNAMA’s latest mandate, noting in particular Security Council Resolution 2626 of 17 March 2022, which has reiterated UNAMA’s role in support of the people of Afghanistan.

department.narrative: ASIA, OCEANIA, LATIN AMERICA AND THE CARIBBEAN
